Power Steering Pump Fault + Low Oil

Failed Ignition System.description: Clicking or grinding on startup. Ignition switch or starter motor has failed.

Dead or Weak Battery.urgency_label: 🟠 High — Jump start or replace battery
Dead or Weak Battery.description: Slow cranking or single click. Battery is critically discharged or alternator is not charging.

Low Engine Oil Level.urgency_label: 🟠 High — Top up engine oil immediately
Low Engine Oil Level.description: Ticking or rattling from engine. Oil level is critically low. Stop driving and top up immediately.

Low Oil + Worn Serpentine Belt.description: Combined ticking (low oil) and squealing (serpentine belt). Both require immediate attention.

Normal Engine Idle.description: Engine is idling smoothly. No fault detected.

Power Steering Pump Fault + Low Oil.description: Whining power steering pump combined with engine ticking from low oil.

Power Steering + Low Oil + Serpentine Be.description: Three concurrent faults. Do not drive. Requires full inspection immediately.

Power Steering Pump + Serpentine Belt Fa.description: Power steering whine combined with serpentine belt squeal. Belt may be driving the pump.

Power Steering Pump Fault.urgency_label: 🟡 Medium — Repair within a few days
Power Steering Pump Fault.description: Whining or groaning from power steering pump when turning. Check fluid level.

Worn or Loose Serpentine Belt.description: Squealing from serpentine belt. Can snap suddenly, disabling alternator and power steering.

Worn Brake Pads \u2014 Metal-on-Metal Co.description: Grinding from worn brake pads. Metal-on-metal contact. Braking distance severely compromised.
